text:
inc-bot: ALERT: spot-east-2 GPU pool experiencing rapid preemptions. queue_size=12k (>threshold=1k), avg_latency_tokens=450ms, throttle_rate=90%. Pager duty: paging sarah (oncall).

sarah (oncall): I'm on it. seeing many 503s in the logs and long queue backlog. Marking incident P1.

mike (runtime): Confirmed. autoscaler failed to add new spot instances due to quota errors and hit max_pool_limit=40. Preempt wave started ~1925001200.

anya (eng-sre): devops-bot says many nodes terminated:```
TERMINATION: instance i-0a1b2c3d from spot-east-2, reason=terminate-by-cloudprovider
Autoscaler: scale_up attempt failed: quotaExceeded for region east-2
```

inc-bot: Noted customer impact: 15% of requests are returning 503, 40% greater median latency for hosted API.

javier (cs): We have two paying enterprise customers reporting timeouts. I already escalated via account reps. Need ETA to restore baseline.

emily (infra): Quick wins: (1) bump max_pool_limit to 60 for spot-autoscaler (temporary), (2) kick warm on-demand fallback pool (dedicated fallback) by starting reserved instances in us-east-1. I'll start the launch now.

mike (runtime): Workaround in flight: enable routing policy to prefer 'dedicated-variant' for heavy queues, lower token concurrency per request to reduce KV cache pressure. Patch:```
PATCH: router.policy = "prefer_dedicated_on_high_queue"
apply: /api/v1/routes/route-id/config
```

anya (eng-sre): Also increasing autoscaler cooldown to 90s to avoid thrash, and reducing min_spot_bid to avoid immediate reclaims. But note: quota issues will still block new spot nodes.

devops-bot: Autoscaler log snippet:```
2026-05-07T12:07:24Z autoscaler.INFO scale_up -> request 10 nodes, cloudapi.quota: 0 available
2026-05-07T12:08:10Z autoscaler.ERROR preempt-detection: batch termination 28 nodes
```

sarah (oncall): I'm going to handoff to incident commander. @mike can you take IC? I'll keep PagerDuty channel open and coordinate CS comms.

mike (runtime): I can IC. Objectives: (A) restore <5% 503s, (B) drain queue under 1k items, (C) document root cause. Action list: 1) emily launch on-demand fallback, 2) anya patch autoscaler config, 3) mike enable routing override, 4) javier notify customers w/ ETA 60-90m.

emily (infra): Started on-demand fallback pool: `terraform apply -var='region=us-east-1' -target=module.dedicated_fallback` — instances requested. Expect them up in ~18-25m.

javier (cs): I'll send interim note: "We're experiencing GPU capacity issues due to cloud spot preemptions; traffic reroute and on-demand fallback in progress; estimated restoration in ~60-90 minutes."

mike (runtime): Enabling routing override now. Rolling config out to 3 control-plane instances. Command: `curl -X POST https://console/api/routes/override -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","variant":"dedicated-variant"}'`

inc-bot: System note: config-change by mike (runtime) at 1925001349.

anya (eng-sre): After routing override we see immediate queue drop from 12k -> 6.3k and 503s down from 15% -> 7% within 2 minutes. Good signal.

devops-bot: New dedicated instances registering in pool: i-0f9e8d7c i-00a1b2c3; registration events at 1925001672.

emily (infra): Dedicated fallback pool scaled to 12 GPUs, health checks passing. Still throttling rules in edge caches need to relax for some tenants to reduce 429s.

mike (runtime): Adjusting throttling: increasing per-tenant token_limit by 2x for enterprise customers only. Patch applied.

javier (cs): Customer update: sent to two impacted accounts. Both acknowledge and asked for postmortem.

anya (eng-sre): Monitoring: queue now 900, 503s ~2.8%, median latency trending back to normal. Moving to mitigated but not resolved.

sarah (oncall): Handoff: I'll transition to follow-up (post-incident). @mike stay as IC to finish cleanup and RCA. Documenting action items in #postmortems.

mike (runtime): Immediate root-cause hypothesis: synchronized spot preemptions triggered by upstream provider maintenance + autoscaler hitting conservative max_pool_limit and cloud quota. Fallback policy didn't auto-activate dedicated pool due to bug in scale policy predicate (expected to trigger at queue>1k, but predicate compared to short-lived metric window).

emily (infra): Saving commands and logs to incident bucket: s3://redwood-incidents/1925001234/ — includes autoscaler logs, router changes, terraform plan.

inc-bot: ACTIONS: (1) emily create quota request with cloud provider (high priority), (2) devops to add alert for pool_quota_utilization>80%, (3) eng-releases to patch fallback predicate (PR queued), (4) CS to follow-up customers.

javier (cs): I'll coordinate customer postmortem invites.

mike (runtime): Leaving timeline notes: start 1925001234 alert -> routing override 1925001349 -> dedicated nodes registered 1925001672 -> mitigated 1925001900. Will produce full timeline and RCA.

anya (eng-sre): Closing on-call bridge. Marking incident status: mitigated. Follow-ups required: permanent increase of fallback pool, autoscaler predicate fix, and runbook addition for quota exhaustion.

sarah (oncall): Thanks everyone. Postmortem owner: mike. Target publish ETA: 72h. Closing bridge. :white_check_mark:
